title: International Nursing Exchange Students Find Second Home at Augustana University, Extend Stay
summary_en: When Hannah Roland ‘26 and Knut Opheim ‘26 arrived at Augustana University, the Norwegian nursing students expected to stay for just one semester. Within weeks, a supportive community, busy campus life and new friendships convinced them to extend their stay to a full academic year.
title_cn: International Nursing Exchange Students Find Second Home at Augustana University, Extend Stay
